question: The book ‘All Roads Lead to Ganga’ has been written by which famous author?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ruskin Bond**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ruskin Bond** is a renowned Indian author of British descent, well-known for his contributions to children's literature.
 
• The book **'All Roads Lead to Ganga'** is one of Bond's notable works, reflecting his deep connection with the Himalayan region.
 
• Published in **2005**, the book is a collection of essays that capture the beauty and serenity of the Indian Himalayas.
 
• Bond's writings often draw from his personal experiences and his life in the hill stations of India, particularly in **Mussoorie**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ruskin Bond's Background**

 
 
• Born on May 19, 1934, in Kasauli, Himachal Pradesh, India.
 
• He received the **Padma Shri** in 1999 and the **Padma Bhushan** in 2014 for his contributions to literature.
 
 
 
• **Literary Works**
 
 
• Some of his other famous books include *'The Room on the Roof'*, *'The Blue Umbrella'*, and *'A Flight of Pigeons'*.
 
• His works have been adapted into films and television series, bringing his stories to a wider audience.
 
 
 
• **Themes in Bond's Writings**
 
 
• Bond's works often explore themes of nature, love, and the simplicity of rural life.
 
• He frequently writes about the beauty of the Indian landscape, particularly the mountains and forests.
 
 
 
• **Bond's Influence**
 
 
• Ruskin Bond has inspired generations of readers and writers with his storytelling and descriptive writing style.
 
• He remains a beloved figure in Indian literature, especially among young readers.
